Pricing

Large: large biotech, pharmaceutical, hospital, and enterprise organisations.
Medium: small and medium enterprise, academic groups, and clinics.
Single: single-user access.

Product Pricing
Quant
Probabilistic genomic inference comprising Quant Scan, Quant DB, and Quant Calc. State-of-the-art quinary inference with secure local processing for professional, verifiable decision support.		 Large: By agreement
Medium: CHF 38’400
Single: CHF 6’400
Genomic Vault
Long-term genome custody and controlled access.		 Single: CHF 2’400 (10 year)
PanelAppRex AI
Public version, plus private institutional deployment with proprietary features and support.		 Public: Free
Supported: CHF 3’000.
Pedigree
EHR compatible structured clinical pedigrees, record phenotype and genomic findings, and export publication-ready figures, pedigree charts, and technical reports.		 Large: By agreement
Medium: CHF 22’800
Single: CHF 3’800
Public: Free
ACMG Validator
EHR compatible ACMG/AMP criteria, record supporting evidence, confirm non-applicable criteria, and export a structured report. Private by design.		 Large: By agreement
Medium: CHF 22’800
Single: CHF 3’800
Public: Free
QuantBayes
The engine for universal evidence validation, enabling verifiable and compatible decision-making in genomics, with an open core and supported institutional use.		 Open source: Free
Supported: CHF 3’000
QuantBayes Studio
Community support platform, API, and engine implementation behind universal evidence validation. Allows verifiable, compatible decision-making in genomics.		 Large: By agreement
Medium: CHF 800
Single: CHF 180

Open reference framework for auditable variant selection.		 Open source: Free
VCFheader

Scope

Commercial pricing is annual.

Genomic Vault is billed once for ten years of coverage.

Institutional fees vary by organisation size, support scope, and deployment requirements.

For detailed pricing, contact us at admin@switzerlandomics.ch.
